buildings.name: Cottage
buildings.blurb: A small house with a hearth corner, a chest and a workbench.

buildings.name: Smithy
buildings.blurb: Stone workshop with a forge porch: anvil, grindstone, furnaces.

buildings.name: Stable
buildings.blurb: Three open stalls under one roof, with hay and a trough.

buildings.name: Storehouse
buildings.blurb: A tall barn with a cart door, a loft, barrels and chests.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.blurb: A lookout over your land with a brazier on top.

buildings.name: Market Stall
buildings.blurb: A striped awning over a counter. Put one by your gate.

buildings.name: Well
buildings.blurb: A roofed well for the middle of the settlement.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.blurb: Two storeys of books, a reading table and eight Archive Shelves for the town's own lore.

buildings.name: Kitchen Garden
buildings.blurb: Fenced beds with a water channel, ready to plant.
